context-01.translation: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

name-01.translation: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

corpus-02.translation: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-01.translation: Teacher, I really did my homework—but the dog ate it.

corpus-03.translation: Nah, I'm not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

errors.note: “不处”在此语境中意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译文将其具体化为“I'm not dating”，属于增译，添加了原文没有的明确信息，可能误导观众。

slang-01.translation: That move was insane — I'm literally losing it.

corpus-09.translation: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-07.translation: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-10.translation: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

errors.note: 陈述句加问号，标点与句式不匹配，应改为疑问句形式如 "Is that so sudden?" 或 "That's so sudden?" 改为陈述语气。

corpus-11.translation: Fine, I'll deal with all that toxic motivational crap once I'm back in China.

corpus-05.translation: LOL it's just too random—who even gets this question?

corpus-06.translation: Seems like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot clips from his concert.

corpus-08.translation: Plus, his honest, down-to-earth vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-12.translation: So short—did you hit a creative block?

corpus-14.translation: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—who comes out on top?

corpus-19.translation: Look, the lottery numbers I picked are exactly the same as the ones you mentioned yesterday.

corpus-16.translation: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on Moments every day.

errors.note: “Damn”语气偏重且带脏话色彩，原文“我去”是较轻的感叹，用“Wow/Oh man”等更贴合字幕口语。
“朋友圈”译为“Moments”是微信官方英文名，但英文字幕观众未必理解，可考虑“WeChat Moments”或意译。

corpus-18.translation: Not interested. Go play by yourself.

corpus-15.translation: Just look at that fake-deep expression—you can tell something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-17.translation: Not dating. These days, love comes with a price tag.

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译成“Not dating.”意思基本对应，但语气偏书面、缺少原文那种口语化的拒绝/吐槽语气，且与后句衔接略显生硬。

corpus-21.translation: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-20.translation: Hakimi north-south green beans — I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

errors.note: “哈基米”是网络流行语（源自日语“はちみ”，常指可爱小动物/猫咪），音译成“Hakimi”会被误读为足球运动员阿什拉夫·哈基米，属专名误用。
“南北绿豆”是网络梗/无实义谐音串，直译为方位加豆类会让英文观众误以为在讲某种绿豆品种，意思偏差明显。

errors.span: I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk
errors.note: “憋出内伤”指强忍笑意到内伤，译文基本达意但偏解释性、不够口语化，可更简洁自然。

corpus-22.translation: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-28.translation: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.

corpus-23.translation: Was in such a hurry this morning I grabbed the dish rag instead of a towel and brought it to work.

corpus-27.translation: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-29.translation: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.translation: Oh man, I can't even—I'll be laughing about this for a whole year. Who hasn't had an embarrassing story about buying sanitary pads, right?

corpus-34.translation: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and find it hard to focus. Any tips for improving efficiency?

corpus-32.translation: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, just leave me alone.

corpus-24.translation: Not dating. That drama's too much for me to handle.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译成“Not dating”字面接近，但原文此处更可能是“不处（不相处/不处对象）”的省略口语，需结合语境；若原意是“不处对象”则尚可，但“不处”单独出现常表拒绝，译文可能误导。

errors.span: That drama's too much for me to handle.
errors.note: “瓜太大了啃不动”指八卦/事件信息量太大难以消化，译文用“drama”偏向戏剧性冲突，且“too much to handle”侧重难以承受，未准确传达“瓜大（八卦信息量大）啃不动（消化不了）”的含义。

errors.span: That drama's too much for me to handle.
errors.note: 字幕口语中“drama”虽可指八卦，但“too much for me to handle”略显书面，不够口语化。

corpus-38.translation: I was scrolling through videos and saw a Shandong auntie making a super huge jianbing guozi at her stall—now I'm suddenly wondering: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?

corpus-33.translation: Watch Gen Z chat in Martian script

errors.note: “00后”指2000年后出生的人，与“Gen Z”（约1997–2012年出生）并不完全等同，属于范围偏移的误译。
“火星文”是网络俚语/网络黑话，并非火星文字；译成“Martian script”会让观众误以为是外星文字，意思明显偏差。

corpus-39.translation: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-40.translation: I can't take it—this happiness came out of nowhere!

corpus-44.translation: I can't take it anymore—I've been working so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-45.translation: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called, what's it called, Xiaochao Team, right? I remember everything!

corpus-48.translation: I can't, this is way too cute!

corpus-47.translation: Can you stop dragging me into playing games with you?

corpus-41.translation: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

errors.note: “吊睛白额虎”是固定说法，指眼睛上吊、额头白色的猛虎；“white-browed”（白眉）把“白额”（白额/白额头）误译成了白眉毛，细节略有偏差。
“巧乐兹”是品牌名，音译成 Qiaolezi 对英语观众没有意义，宜用官方英文名或加简短说明，否则显得生硬。

corpus-42.translation: Hahaha I can't even, netizens these days are just too talented.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与“我不行了”的夸张语气基本对应，但作为字幕口语略显随意，且与后句衔接稍显生硬。
“这届网友”带有“这一批/这一代网友”的调侃意味，“netizens these days”基本传达，但“这届”的特定网络梗色彩略有流失。

ctx-01.translation: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

corpus-49.translation: I can't do this anymore. I know everything—I've grinded so hard I'm going bald.

errors.span: I've grinded so hard I'm going bald
errors.note: “肝到秃头”是夸张的俚语，指熬夜/拼命工作到掉头发，并非字面意义上的“努力到秃头”；译文按字面理解，丢失了“肝”（熬夜/拼命）的含义。
“我不行了”是口语化的疲惫感叹，译文偏正式、偏字面，语气不够自然。

ctx-c02.translation: Keep it dry, or we'll have to get a new one again.

ctx-02.translation: He said he's not coming home for dinner tonight.

errors.note: 原文是“我妈”（我妈妈），译文却译成“He”，把说话人完全搞错了。

ctx-c05.translation: The power of six wallets—your family must be loaded.

ctx-c38.translation: Sometimes his touch is so insane the audience suspects he's cheating—the chat just spams "666" and they don't even bother booing anymore.

errors.note: 原文“直接666刷屏”指观众刷屏，译文用“the chat”把主体转成了聊天室，略有偏差但可接受。

ctx-c57.translation: LMAO, add an "ah" to that last sentence—it made the boss totally lose it. When introverts snap, they really go hard.

errors.span: add an "ah" to that last sentence
errors.note: 原文“最后那句加点啊”是博主对视频/字幕的评论（建议在最后那句加个“啊”），译文却译成对老板说的话，且“ah”作为语气词处理生硬，改变了说话对象和意思。

errors.span: it made the boss totally lose it
errors.note: “整红温啦”指把老板弄得又气又急/脸红上头，译成“totally lose it”略重且丢失“红温”的调侃色彩，但大意可接受。

m-003.translation: Seriously, are you a total newbie or what?

m-001.translation: Psst—search "brand owner" on Douyin and get your fix with a virtual pet.

errors.note: “主理人”指品牌/店铺的主理人或创始人，译成“brand owner”丢失了“主理人”这一网络流行称谓的特定含义，且与“搜主理人”这一搜索关键词的语境不符。

errors.span: get your fix with a virtual pet
errors.note: “过过瘾”意为满足一下好奇心/解解馋，“get your fix”偏指满足瘾头，语义略有偏移，但整体可理解。
“抖音电子宠物”译为“virtual pet”，漏掉了“抖音”这一平台限定，弱化了“抖音电子宠物”这一特定玩法。

m-004.translation: There's always someone who keeps quoting movie lines when we play poker.

m-002.translation: I'd suggest taking your parents to a store to try out the system's responsiveness in person. For storage, go with the 12+256GB version.

errors.note: 原文“内存”指运行内存（RAM），译文误译为“storage”（存储），导致技术信息错误。
原文“12+256G”指内存+存储规格，译文加“B”虽常见，但与原文单位表述不完全一致，且未体现“内存”含义。

m-005.translation: Saw a little dog by the roadside wagging its tail at me.

m-006.translation: Guess what? Our school cafeteria was actually free today!

errors.note: 原文“今天居然免费”指今天这一餐/活动免费，译文用“was free”容易被理解为食堂本身今天免费（如入场免费），且“actually”位置使语气偏向“竟然真的免费”，与“居然”的意外语气略有偏差。

m-007.translation: Hahahaha I can picture it so vividly.

m-010.translation: Lately I've noticed a lot of my friends are into stand-up comedy—even my parents have started watching it.

m-008.translation: I'm not obligated to tell you — it's my little secret.

m-012.translation: I have to finish reading this document today.

errors.note: 原文“这份文件今天必须看完”是客观要求（文件必须被看完），译文用“I have to”变成说话人主观义务，且丢失了“今天”这一时间限制。

m-013.translation: Some people say I'm so fair-skinned I look mixed-race.

m-011.translation: I just found out my mom gave away my prized figurine collection.

m-009.translation: Can you become a pro just by posting weird shit? Are you the plagiarism police or something?

errors.note: “玩抽象”指玩梗/搞抽象幽默，译成“posting weird shit”把含义窄化为发奇怪内容，且粗俗化，偏离原意。
原文“你是鉴抄警察吗”是直接质问，译文加“or something”增添了原文没有的轻蔑/不确定语气。

m-014.translation: Last night while gaming, I just found out that holding down this key triggers your ultimate.

errors.note: 原文未指明人称，用 your 引入了原文没有的第二人称，与说话者自身经历（I just found out）不一致，宜用 my/the ultimate。

m-015.translation: Girl, I can't even—this gossip is way too juicy.

m-016.translation: Remember to bring a big lightweight cloth bag to carry everything—a backpack's a hassle at the beach.

m-017.translation: This streamer's story is way too crazy, right?

m-019.translation: I really can't take it anymore—my stomach's about to explode.

m-018.translation: This game's difficulty is absolutely ridiculous.

m-022.translation: Li Zongheng's performance was absolutely brilliant—he could easily make it onto the big stage any minute.

m-020.translation: And all that 'so what, what are you gonna do' crap—it makes me want to crap, it's as brainwashing as a virus.

errors.span: so what, what are you gonna do
errors.note: 原文“那咋了又能怎”是口语化的“那又怎样/又能怎么办”，译文拆成两句疑问，语气略重，但意思基本对应。
原文“那什么……听得我想拉屎”中“那什么”是含糊指代，译文用 crap 兼作脏话和“屎”，虽双关但把原文的粗俗直白转为英语脏话，语气略有偏移。

errors.span: it's as brainwashing as a virus
errors.note: “brainwashing”作形容词搭配 as...as 结构生硬，英语中更自然说法是“as brainwashing as a virus”虽可理解但不够地道，属措辞不自然。

m-023.translation: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? I'm going to catch up on it right now.

m-027.translation: What do you guys even mean by 'yes-man'?

m-026.translation: So now every time I just say, 'Then deal with it.' Let him get a taste of what it's like to suffer in silence.

m-025.translation: Starting the lesson at zero frames—no warm-up at all? This coach must be a former esports player.

errors.span: Starting the lesson at zero frames
errors.note: “0帧教学”是网络用语，指毫无铺垫/准备直接开始，译成“at zero frames”字面直译，英语观众无法理解其含义，意思明显偏差。
原文“连热身动作都省了”是陈述语气，译文改为反问，语气略有偏差。

errors.span: This coach must be a former esports player.
errors.note: 原文“电竞选手转行的吧”带有调侃推测语气，译文用陈述句“must be”稍显确定，且“转行”意味略弱。

m-024.translation: Everyone here must be crying from how anxious you are!

errors.span: must be crying from how anxious you are
errors.note: 原文“你已急哭了吧”是说话人调侃/质问对方（“你”=观众/对方）急得要哭，译文却把“crying”的主语变成“everyone here”，并把“you”处理成焦虑的来源，主客体颠倒，意思明显偏差。
原文“在座的各位”是称呼语，译文将其并入主句主语，弱化了原句“各位……你……”的呼告语气。

m-029.translation: Made me waste so much time.

m-028.translation: Your pronunciation is so cursed—I can't stop listening.

errors.note: 原文无此内容，属增译，添加了原文没有的“忍不住一直听”之意。
“魔性”指洗脑、上头、魔幻搞笑，用 cursed 偏“邪门/被诅咒”，语气不太贴合，但大致可理解。

m-031.translation: Haven't you noticed he always spins around on the red carpet at every big event?

m-034.translation: I can't take this group anymore.

errors.note: “这群”指这群人/这个地方，译成“this group”把“这群人”误解为“这个团体”，意思有偏差。

m-032.translation: I've noticed a guy keeps leaving marks on my water bottle lately.

m-035.translation: The PPT the teacher showed in class was so hilarious.

m-033.translation: Brother B acts out that relatable moment from school days when you're listening attentively in class and suddenly get hit by a wave of inexplicable anger.

m-037.translation: Let me show you a trick.

m-036.translation: When I watch funny videos, I hold back my laughter and don't dare make a sound.

m-038.translation: I'd suggest you go through all of them—after all, last year's test-takers said that question 'definitely wouldn't be on the exam,' and it still showed up in the end.

m-039.translation: I heard Nestlé's making an indie film.

m-043.translation: I can't—your contact name is killing me, that's brutal.

m-044.translation: This is way funnier than the skits on the Spring Festival Gala.

m-041.translation: That's so bizarre—what kind of brand-new tactic is this?

m-040.translation: I can't even—this looks way too much like it.

errors.span: this looks way too much like it
errors.note: “太像了”指某人或某物与另一对象相似，译文用代词“it”指代不明，且“looks like it”易被理解为“看起来是这样”，偏离原意。
“我不行了”在此语境是感叹“受不了/太夸张了”，译为“I can't even—”偏网络流行语的无奈语气，与原文惊叹语气略有出入。

m-045.translation: I can't take it anymore—getting woken up in the middle of the night is just too much.

m-047.translation: I'm planning to start learning Python programming with absolutely no experience. Where should I start?

m-048.translation: My blind date talked about her cat the whole time.

m-042.translation: Back in the day, I was riding high—my skills raked in cash from every direction. Now look at me, shining shoes here.

errors.span: my skills raked in cash from every direction
errors.note: “一手技能牌”指打牌/牌技（技能牌），译文译成泛指的“skills”丢失了“牌”的意象，但整体意思大致保留。
“riding high”侧重得意/顺遂，未体现“意气风发”的精神饱满、意气昂扬，略有弱化。

m-049.translation: As a new content creator, I've noticed my videos get decent views, but the comment section is always pretty quiet.

m-046.translation: If you've got fleas, go take a shower—you made my phone stink.

errors.note: 原文“把我手机整的骚哄的”指说话人自己的手机被弄得有异味，译文却用“you made my phone stink”把责任归于对方，且“my phone”与原文“我手机”虽对应，但整句因果关系和主语指向有偏差，容易让观众误解为对方弄臭了说话人的手机。
“骚哄的”是口语化、带方言色彩的贬义表达，译文“stink”只传达“臭”，语气和生动程度有所减弱，但基本可接受。

m-051.translation: Quick, let me pinch myself to see if I'm dreaming.

m-050.translation: Remember, you don't need much gear at the start—the key is to shoot a lot and practice a lot.

m-053.translation: Work's been really stressful lately—I get so anxious I can't sleep. Any ways to relieve it?

m-054.translation: If it's all about luck, why bother checking the gear?

m-052.translation: You're literally crying—this is colder than the cold palace.

errors.note: “你已急哭”是夸张/调侃的说法（意为“你急得要哭了”），并非陈述对方真的在哭；译成“literally crying”把比喻坐实，改变了原意。
“冷宫”直译为“cold palace”对不熟悉中国宫廷文化的英语观众不易理解，且“colder than the cold palace”读起来生硬，可考虑意译或加注式表达。

m-055.translation: Dorm contraband check — and a condom dropped out from under my roommate's pillow.

errors.note: 缺少动词，读起来像标题而非口语叙述，字幕中略显生硬。
原文“舍友”指室友，译文用“my roommate”可接受，但“舍友”未必是说话人的室友，属轻微增译。

m-057.translation: My mom said she wants to set me up with someone.

m-056.translation: Guys, I'm still dead over here.

m-059.translation: Saw a video of a delivery guy delivering food in the rain

errors.note: 字幕中省略主语“I”虽可接受，但作为独立句子略显不完整，加“I”更自然。

m-060.translation: The exam answer is on page 50 of the textbook.

m-061.translation: Girls, what do I do? This move has me totally swooning.

m-058.translation: Update it again and I'll come back to China and beat your ass.

errors.note: “再更新”指“下次更新/再更新一次”，译成“Update it again”带有“再更新一次（重复动作）”的指令语气，且“it”指代不明，与原文“等下次更新时再回来收拾你”的威胁语境有偏差。
“回国”指说话人回到自己的国家，译文“come back to China”把国别具体化，若说话人并非中国人或语境未明确为中国则不准确。
“弄你”为口语威胁，译成“beat your ass”语气过重且偏粗俗，与原文相对含糊的“弄你”不完全对应。

m-062.translation: My feed is nothing but people spamming "666" — it's honestly making my skin crawl.

m-063.translation: Help me cop the limited-edition sneakers

m-064.translation: I have my teacher certification interview next week—any special tips for the demo lesson part?

m-066.translation: I can't understand a thing on the English listening exam.

m-065.translation: There's this guy in the next class who poses all melancholy in front of the mirror after class and says he's the male lead of that xxx drama.

errors.span: poses all melancholy in front of the mirror
errors.note: “poses all melancholy”搭配生硬，口语中更自然说法是“strikes a melancholy pose”或“poses moodily”。
原文“xxx剧”是泛指某部剧（相当于“some drama”），用“that”暗示双方已知的特定剧集，略有偏差。

m-068.translation: I can't take it anymore! Listening to this is making my brain turn to mush!

m-067.translation: I can't even—I'm dying laughing, this impression is so spot-on it's basically a perfect copy of the original. Absolutely legendary. Not even trying to hide it—this one is a total drama queen.

errors.note: “六百六十六”（网络用语，意为“厉害/牛”）被完全漏译，译文用“Absolutely legendary”替代，丢失了原文的具体表达。
“装都不装了”意为“连装都不装了”，译文“Not even trying to hide it”基本达意，但略偏“不掩饰”，与原意“不再假装”有细微偏差。

m-069.translation: What does this Moments post my partner posted mean?

errors.span: this Moments post my partner posted
errors.note: “post”与“posted”重复冗余，措辞不够自然，可改为“this Moments post from my partner”。

m-070.translation: I just dropped a meme I'd been saving up for a whole year in the group chat, and it totally fell flat.

m-072.translation: I can't take it anymore—this is way too intense.

m-074.translation: Ideally somewhere you can take photos and post them.

m-073.translation: Li Zongheng stars in a story about a father-in-law who loves to play pranks, showing the Spring Festival fun as this generation of young people starts to take charge.

m-071.translation: You're literally crying from panic—answer me, answer me!

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张说法，指急得快哭/被逼急，并非真的在哭；“literally crying”把它误译成字面意义的哭泣，改变了意思。

errors.note: 原文“室友”是复数（她们），译文用单数 roommate 且后文用 she，丢失了多人信息。
原文“她们说”为复数，译文改为单数 she，与原文不符。
原文“笑死”是自嘲式吐槽，译文拆成 LOL 加 hilarious 略显重复、语气偏夸张，不够自然。

m-516.translation: I'm done—let me lie down for a bit first.

errors.note: “我不行了”表示体力不支或撑不住了，而“I'm done”通常表示放弃或受够了，意思有偏差。

errors.span: let me lie down for a bit first
errors.note: “first”放在句末略显生硬，口语字幕中通常省略或改用更自然的表达。

m-522.translation: Why don't you go on a talent show?

m-523.translation: We recommend chartering a car for the whole trip or joining a small group tour—public transportation isn't very convenient.

m-520.translation: My blind date suddenly put on their ex's favorite song.

errors.note: 原文“前任”未指明性别，但“their”与单数“blind date”搭配在此语境下指代不清，且“their ex”可能被理解为相亲对象本人的前任，而原文“前任”更可能指说话者/他人的前任，造成指代歧义。
“put on”偏口语但可接受；不过“suddenly put on their ex's favorite song”略显生硬，更自然说法如“started playing”。

m-521.translation: They went public three months ago—the whole internet knows. Only you're still in the super topic farming stats every day.

errors.note: “超话”是微博的“super topic”，但英文观众通常不熟悉；直译生硬，宜用更通用的说法或加解释。
“刷数据”指刷互动量/数据，farming stats 略显生硬，但意思可理解。
“Only you're still...” 句法不完整、不自然，宜改为 “but you're still...” 或 “only you are still...”。

m-524.translation: I remember you saying last week you were socially anxious—that's a huge 180!

errors.note: “180”在英语口语中通常说“180”或“complete 180”，但“a huge 180”略显生硬，不过仍可理解。

m-526.translation: Or Daniel, the one who sings?

m-527.translation: My boyfriend and I keep arguing over little things—like who does the dishes or showing up late to dates. How can we improve the way we get along?

m-525.translation: Why do you keep watching all this weird stuff every day? Watch something normal—your brain's gonna get fried. Hurry up and switch to something healthier.

m-530.translation: Avoid all-black suits—they're too formal—and don't wear jeans either.

m-531.translation: Fine, I'll deal with these paid trolls when I'm back in China.

m-534.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I'm gonna go grab tickets right now!

m-529.translation: Born to be absolutely unhinged—seeing this just made my brain crash.

errors.note: “天生抽象圣体”是网络梗，指人天生自带荒诞/抽象气质；“born to be absolutely unhinged”传达了大致意思，但“圣体”这一夸张戏谑的说法被弱化，语气略有偏差。

errors.span: seeing this just made my brain crash
errors.note: “大脑宕机”译成“brain crash”略显生硬，英语口语中更常说“my brain just crashed”或“my brain stopped working”，此处措辞不够自然。

m-535.translation: But I think it's really sacred—every photo is a memory.

m-533.translation: But doesn't anyone else find the word "annoying" itself annoying? (I'm outta here—I can't even spell.)

errors.note: “丈育”是网络用语，指“文盲/不识字”，此处译为“I can't even spell”把自嘲的“文盲”梗窄化成“不会拼写”，意思有明显偏差。
“溜了溜了”是网络口语化的“先撤了”，译成“I'm outta here”语气偏直白，缺少原文的俏皮网络感。

m-532.translation: The 100,000 Memes series showcases the 'read it, reply nonsense' meme — proof of excellent mental health.

errors.note: “十万个梗库”是系列名称，直译为“100,000 Memes”会让英文观众误以为是一万个梗的合集，而非专有系列名。
“已读乱回”是网络流行语，此处直译生硬，不像字幕口语，建议意译如“read-but-reply-randomly”。
原文“精神状态良好”是反讽调侃，译文“proof of excellent mental health”语气偏正面陈述，反讽意味有所减弱。

m-528.translation: Fishy, rank, lecherous, gamey, and greasy—a total cesspool of every vice.

errors.span: Fishy, rank, lecherous, gamey, and greasy
errors.note: “腥骚色膻油”指五种气味/味道（腥、骚、色/膻、膻、油），译文把“色”误译为“lecherous”（好色的），把气味词变成性格词，意思明显偏差。

errors.span: a total cesspool of every vice
errors.note: 原文只是罗列五种气味/味道，译文增译成“所有恶习的污水池”，添加了原文没有的道德评判含义。

errors.span: Fishy, rank, lecherous, gamey, and greasy—a total cesspool of every vice.
errors.note: 译文用词偏书面、堆砌，不像中文字幕口语化表达，且破折号后的解释显得生硬。

m-536.translation: I already felt awful, and now laughing's making my stomach hurt even more.

m-538.translation: So what? Who cares? Watch it or don't—whatever.

m-543.translation: I hope to see you and Jia Ling perform a comedy sketch at next year's Spring Festival Gala!

m-540.translation: At first I thought she was a total bleeding heart—turns out it was Satan telling the story.

m-539.translation: So what? I'm gonna watch it—and I'll use your membership to do it. Love yourself, see you every day.

errors.note: “爱你老己”是网络用语/昵称式说法（“老己”指自己，带调侃语气），译成“Love yourself”变成泛泛的励志口号，意思和语气都偏了。
“天天见”更像“每天见/天天见”的口语收尾，译成“see you every day”尚可，但与前句连读时语义衔接生硬，像是把两句强行拼接。

m-541.translation: Why do you watch such ridiculous stuff every day? Watch something normal—my whole worldview is getting messed up.

m-544.translation: That was a bit hasty of me—I should've saved it for the New Year's Eve show.

m-542.translation: No thanks, with that IQ you might as well give up gaming.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不处对象/不交往”，并非“不用谢/不必了”，译成“No thanks”属误译，改变了原意。

m-545.translation: Wealth from all sides, luck that never ends, youthful beauty, family in good health—even your boss would give you a raise after seeing this.

errors.note: 原文“老板看了都得给你加薪”是泛指看到你的好运/状态，译文“after seeing this”指代模糊，且“this”在字幕语境中缺乏明确所指，造成意思偏差。
“八方来财”译为“Wealth from all sides”偏直译生硬，作为口语化祝福字幕不够自然。

m-549.translation: With cooking like this, why hasn't Michelin poached you yet?

m-547.translation: Just switched to a new lipstick shade.

m-546.translation: I'll send you a screenshot, take a look — guaranteed to have you laughing your head off hahaha

m-551.translation: I'm preparing for the teacher certification exam—how should I get ready for the teaching ability test?

m-548.translation: Let me give you all a quick rundown on where this meme came from and how it evolved.

m-552.translation: I'm looking for a lighthearted, feel-good movie to watch this weekend—ideally something visually beautiful with a heartwarming story. Any recommendations?

m-550.translation: Not dating. What's so funny about that?

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，但更可能是“不处”作为“不”的俏皮说法或“不处（不相处）”，译成“Not dating”把意思完全固定为“不约会”，与原文语境（回应“这有啥好笑的”）不符，属于严重误译。
原文“这有啥好笑的”是反问，译文基本对应，但“that”指代前句“not dating”，因前句误译导致整句逻辑偏离。

m-554.translation: The boss says we can't leave until we've gone through all 100 slides.

m-553.translation: I just started working out, and my muscles get really sore after every strength training session. Is that normal?

m-555.translation: You got it, bro—consider it done!

m-556.translation: Hey, I see you're pretty active in the comments—want to add each other and chat?

m-558.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? Come on, show us what you've got!

m-557.translation: See the message, reply with nonsense—just doing whatever I feel like.

errors.span: See the message, reply with nonsense
errors.note: “已读乱回”是网络流行语，指已读消息后胡乱回复，译文“See the message, reply with nonsense”将其拆成两个并列动作，丢失了“已读却乱回”的转折与梗义，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: just doing whatever I feel like
errors.note: “主打一个随心所欲”是口语化网络表达，译文偏书面、解释性，作为字幕不够口语自然。

m-560.translation: This streamer is terrible at games, yet has a million followers.

m-562.translation: There are plenty of fish in the sea.

m-561.translation: Alright, alright, I'm going to queue up right now!

m-559.translation: My review: You're so stressed you're crying — life's just too hard.

errors.note: “急哭”指因焦急/着急而哭，译文改成“压力大而哭”，改变了情绪原因，意思有明显偏差。
“生活太难了”是口语感叹，译文加“just”并调整语序，略显生硬，但可接受。

m-565.translation: Why did the person in this video suddenly switch up their style?

m-566.translation: I sent the wrong message in the company group chat.

m-564.translation: You cry that fast—how is anyone else supposed to get in line?

m-563.translation: Fun fact: Douyin doesn't let you repost the same photo, so this absolute legend's album genuinely has a hundred different 'crying from frustration' memes of you.

errors.span: a hundred different 'crying from frustration' memes of you
errors.note: 原文“一百张你已急哭”指一百张“你已急哭”的图片/照片，译文增译“different”并改称“memes”，且“of you”位置使意思变为“关于你的表情包”，与原文“一百张（你已急哭的）照片”有偏差。
“神人”译为“absolute legend”语气偏褒义/网络化，原文略带调侃，尚可接受但略不贴切。

m-568.translation: My boss said my proposal reads like a fifth grader wrote it.

m-569.translation: Does this number have any special meaning?

m-570.translation: Remember, building muscle is a long-term process. You'll see the fastest progress in the first 3 months during the newbie gains phase—patience is key.

m-567.translation: Young people these days really stand their ground during the New Year—unlike us as kids, who just had to quietly endure our relatives' soul-crushing questions.

m-573.translation: Isn't it too dangerous for this show to have elderly people perform?

m-572.translation: I can't even, hahaha—this is so addictive!

m-571.translation: I can't even — you're flexing so hard I'm gonna cry.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此是“受不了/招架不住”的意思，译成网络流行语“I can't even”偏向无语/震惊，语义略有偏移。
“秀”用“flexing”可接受，但“so hard”略显夸张生硬，与“要被你秀哭了”的调侃语气不完全贴合。

m-574.translation: You think keeping up with memes is easy? I have to scroll through short videos for eight hours a day just to catch up.

m-577.translation: Have you seen Li Zongheng's recent performance?

m-576.translation: My hand slipped and I used my ult in the wrong direction.

m-575.translation: The pandemic took all the positives away, and everyone left is negative.

errors.span: The pandemic took all the positives away, and everyone left is negative.
errors.note: 原文是双关语："阳"（新冠阳性）和"阴"（阴性）被字面译成 positives/negative，丢失了"阳/阴"的检测结果双关，英文观众会误以为指乐观/悲观的人。
译文生硬直译，未体现原文"把阳的人全带走（去世/离开）"的口语双关意味，语气不对。

m-580.translation: Take this seriously and teach him a lesson.

m-579.translation: I feel like a lot of people in the comments are dying to show off their talent for shitposting.

errors.note: “抽象”在此网络语境指荒诞、无厘头的幽默/整活，译成 shitposting 偏向“发垃圾帖/钓鱼帖”，语义有明显偏差。

m-581.translation: Oh for sure, I completely lost my mind.

errors.note: “心态崩了”指情绪崩溃、受不了，而“lost my mind”意为发疯/精神失常，语义有明显偏差。

m-582.translation: Mom really gets you—the moment you scroll to a hot guy, you pause and watch it over and over.

m-584.translation: Pulling an all-nighter at the internet café and suddenly I'm starving.

m-583.translation: Bro got too greedy this round — and it made for absolute peak entertainment.

m-578.translation: My roommate suddenly yelled 'I wanna check the cards!' in the dorm, and we were all totally baffled.

errors.note: “验牌”指查验/核实牌（如检查牌是否合规、有无问题），译成“check the cards”偏字面且语义模糊，未能准确传达“验”的核验含义。
字幕口语中“wanna”尚可，但整体语气与宿舍突然大喊的戏剧感略不匹配，可更口语化、更有冲击力。

m-586.translation: I can't go on—I'm so worn out I can't even walk anymore.

m-588.translation: I dare not speak too loud—lest I startle the yes-men.

m-587.translation: All three have solid displays, and the 120Hz high refresh rate makes videos look really smooth.

m-590.translation: Those clickbait accounts are ripping off my ideas again.

m-585.translation: The blogger got totally mesmerized by a crazy pigeon and even started dancing to the beat.

errors.note: “硬控”指被牢牢吸引、无法移开视线/被拿捏，译成“mesmerized”（着迷）弱化了被控制、无法自拔的意味，语义有偏差。

errors.span: even started dancing to the beat
errors.note: “卡点舞”指踩着节拍/卡点跳舞，译文基本传达，但“started dancing”略增“开始”之意，且未体现“卡点”的精准踩点感。

m-592.translation: We don't call it working overtime and pulling all-nighters—we call it artistic creation.

m-589.translation: I can't take it anymore. This is my turf—kindly get on your knees.

errors.note: “kindly”过于正式、书面化，与“麻烦你跪下”这种口语化、带威胁/命令语气的字幕对白不符，显得生硬。

m-594.translation: That's a savage take—you're the first person to say that.

m-593.translation: I'm preparing for the civil service exam, but I keep doing badly on the quantitative relationship questions in the administrative aptitude test. Are there any targeted ways to improve?

m-595.translation: The most awkward part is that I just happened to have money in my pocket.

m-597.translation: Sent a message in the group chat and got left on read.

m-596.translation: I'm dying laughing, this is pure absurdity — that sleeping position is way too artistic.

m-598.translation: You can just type in xnxf to use this feature.

m-601.translation: I put on another three pounds.

m-602.translation: At least it didn't hit you with a pile of crap right off the bat.

m-605.translation: The team leader said we should handle problems on our own when he's not around.

m-600.translation: Back in touch with the ex again. Because of the baby? Can't even hold their shit, loves eating shit.

errors.span: Can't even hold their shit, loves eating shit.
errors.note: 原文“兜不住屎 喜欢吃屎”是两句并列的粗俗描述，译文用逗号连成一句并省略主语，把“兜不住屎”误读为“忍不住/憋不住屎”，且“their”指代不明，意思有明显偏差。
字幕口语中缺少主语，与前句衔接生硬，读起来像残句。

m-603.translation: You saved money on eyeliner and got a Western-style makeup look for free. I suggest you take a photo and post it on social media saying it's the latest trendy makeup look—it'll definitely go viral.

errors.note: 原文特指“朋友圈”（微信朋友圈），译成泛指的 social media 丢失了具体平台信息。
原文“欧美妆”是口语化说法，译成 Western-style makeup look 偏书面生硬，字幕口语感不足。

m-607.translation: Desperately need a set of Shiba Inu emojis that capture the office worker life.

errors.note: “打工人”是网络流行语，指受雇的上班族/打工者，译为“office worker”偏窄，遗漏了非办公室打工群体，但整体意思基本传达。

m-606.translation: Slacking off at work, I came across a super awkward Moments post from a colleague.

m-610.translation: It took you until now to realize that's the point I was making?

m-609.translation: I haven't bought an oven yet—is there a simple recipe that doesn't need one?

m-611.translation: I really don't have time to mess around with you—this ranked match is way too important.

m-613.translation: The teacher asked me why I didn't turn in my homework.

m-614.translation: Do you know my new WeChat name?

m-612.translation: At the same time, I'm particularly drawn to your company's XX culture (employee development, technological innovation, etc.).

m-608.translation: Sorry, but this is so cringe I want the ground to swallow me whole—I'd give anything to move to another planet right now.

errors.span: I want the ground to swallow me whole
errors.note: 原文“脚趾抠地”是尴尬的夸张说法，译文改成了“想钻地缝”，意思接近但换了比喻，属于轻微改写而非严格对应。

errors.span: I'd give anything to move to another planet right now
errors.note: 原文“恨不得当场换个星球生活”是口语化夸张，译文“I'd give anything to...”略显书面、啰嗦，不够像字幕口语。

m-615.translation: Just got out of the shower and realized I forgot my towel.

m-616.translation: Such a random joke, but I actually laughed out loud.

m-619.translation: Watching your video on the subway and trying not to laugh is killing me.

m-618.translation: Please, art team, when are you finally going to give this goddess a costume that actually fits her character?

m-617.translation: Get online and play with me—we just need you!

errors.note: “就差你一个了”意为只缺你一人（还差一个人），译文“we just need you”变成“我们只需要你”，意思偏差。

m-620.translation: Can we get hold of the key points for this exam?

errors.span: get hold of the key points
errors.note: “get hold of”偏书面/正式，口语字幕中更自然的是“get the key points”或“get the inside info”，语气略显生硬。

m-621.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I thought that was just being real and unpretentious.

m-623.translation: Don't even mention it—my wallet's about to take another hit.

m-622.translation: It's best to wait and open it on your birthday—if you open it now, there'll be no surprise left.

m-625.translation: My mom is dead set on making me go on a blind date.

m-626.translation: What should I do when video chats with my long-distance boyfriend often hit awkward silences and I can't find anything to talk about?

m-624.translation: What do you mean 'I'm not telling'? You had a change of heart way too suddenly!

errors.span: You had a change of heart
errors.note: “觉醒”指突然醒悟/意识到某事，译成“change of heart”（改变主意/变心）意思有偏差，应为“woke up/realized it”之类。
“way too suddenly”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“so suddenly”或“out of nowhere”。

m-628.translation: So what? Isn't that just standard relationship stuff?

m-629.translation: The boss said we have to work overtime to review the surveillance footage.

m-627.translation: You'd watch it like it's the Spring Festival Gala?

errors.span: You'd watch it like it's the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 原文“相当春晚看啊？”是反问/感叹，意思是“这简直像在看春晚”，并非“你会像看春晚那样去看它吗”，译文把陈述性感叹误译成了疑问句，改变了语气和意思。

errors.span: You'd watch it like it's the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 译文句式偏书面、生硬，不像口语字幕；中文原句是简短的口语感叹。

m-630.translation: I've been wanting to get into fitness and build muscle lately, but I have no idea where to start.

m-636.translation: I was holding back laughter on the subway just now and nearly died trying.

m-634.translation: Do I really have to go to the weekend team-building event?

m-637.translation: Can I request a song first?

m-631.translation: You're the biggest keyboard warrior there is—even keyboards see you and go, "Now that's a real key-board!"

errors.note: 原文“键盘”是双关玩梗（键盘/键），并非指网络上的“keyboard warrior”（键盘侠），译文改变了含义。
原文“好键啊好键”是对“键”字的谐音玩梗，译文生造“key-board”拆词，未能传达原双关，且意思偏离。

errors.span: You're the biggest keyboard warrior there is
errors.note: 语气偏书面、冗长，不像口语字幕。

m-633.translation: I worked overtime till the early hours, and my colleague said I was just faking hard work.

errors.span: I worked overtime till the early hours
errors.note: 原文只说“加班到凌晨”，译文加了“till the early hours”，把时间点扩成时段，略有增译。
“装努力”是口语化吐槽，译成“faking hard work”偏书面生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-635.translation: The cafeteria ladies this year are absolutely unhinged.

errors.note: “unhinged”偏指精神失常/疯狂，而“抽象”是网络用语，指行为离谱、莫名其妙，语气更轻松调侃，此处略重且不够贴合口语梗味。

m-632.translation: When it comes to replying nonsense to messages you've read, I only trust Zhazhahui and his grandpa.

errors.span: replying nonsense to messages you've read
errors.note: “已读乱回”指已读消息后胡乱回复，译文“replying nonsense to messages you've read”把“已读”误解为修饰消息，且“乱回”的随意敷衍语气被弱化。
“我只认准”是“我只认可/只服”的意思，译成“I only trust”偏指信任，语义略有偏差。
“渣渣辉”是知名网络昵称，音译 Zhazhahui 可接受，但未体现其作为专有昵称的常见译法，观众可能难以识别。

m-639.translation: My colleague keeps dumping work on me.

errors.note: 原文开头的表情符号🉑在译文中被省略，字幕中表情符号通常承载语气，漏掉会轻微损失语气信息。

m-791.translation: Only started writing the answers in the last ten minutes of the exam.

errors.note: 缺少主语，句子不完整，读起来像残句，不像完整的字幕句子。

m-789.translation: I don't usually like weird stuff, but weird the way you are? I love it hahaha

errors.note: 句子结构不完整、语法不通，应为“weird in the way you are”或“weird like you”之类。

errors.span: weird the way you are? I love it
errors.note: 问号加生硬断句不符合字幕口语语气，原文是连贯的转折句。

m-790.translation: Wake me up at six on a weekend morning to study

errors.span: Wake me up at six on a weekend morning to study
errors.note: 原文是说话人请求对方在周末早上六点叫自己起来学习（祈使/请求语气，隐含“叫我”），译文用“Wake me up...”虽保留了祈使，但“on a weekend morning”泛化为“某个周末早上”，且整体读作“在周末早上六点叫醒我去学习”，与原文“周末早上六点叫我起来学习”意思基本对应，但“a weekend morning”不如“weekend mornings”贴合习惯性安排，属轻微偏差。

m-793.translation: Can't afford to mess up a trick question like that.

m-795.translation: Lately, a lot of kids in the neighborhood have gone missing.

m-798.translation: I'm done. I'm running on empty.

m-797.translation: I don't believe it unless you put it on and show me.

m-794.translation: Kids these days—all they say is "no problem, no problem."

errors.note: “包的”是网络流行语，意为“肯定/没问题”，但译文将其处理为“no problem, no problem”，丢失了原文“天天挂在嘴边”的重复口头禅意味，且“包的”在此语境更接近“稳了/肯定行”，译成“no problem”有偏差。
原文“天天包的包的”强调频繁说这句话，译文“all they say is”略有增译，暗示他们只说这一句，程度稍过。

m-796.translation: Suddenly it all clicks—like a master carving an ox.

errors.note: “瞬间理解”指立刻明白/领会，译文改成“突然一切都想通了”，把“理解庖丁解牛”这一具体对象泛化，丢失了原文的“理解”含义。

errors.span: like a master carving an ox
errors.note: 原文“庖丁解牛”是成语典故，指理解其精髓；译文变成“像大师在解牛”的明喻，把“理解庖丁解牛”误译成“像庖丁一样解牛”，意思明显偏差。

m-801.translation: The boss said it was a team-building event, but it's actually just working overtime.

m-803.translation: Why is nothing happening when I keep pressing save?

m-800.translation: Play for fun, never rank up—just browsing around the streaming section.

errors.span: Play for fun, never rank up
errors.note: “爱玩不上分”是描述一种随性、不追求排位的玩家状态，译文用祈使句“Play for fun, never rank up”读起来像在给指令，语气略有偏差。

errors.span: just browsing around the streaming section
errors.note: “在直播区乱逛”的“乱逛”带有随意、漫无目的的口语感，译文“browsing around”偏正式，字幕口语感稍弱。

m-805.translation: For the last month, keep up 3 hours of efficient study every day. Your memory's best in the morning, so that's a good time to memorize long-answer questions.

m-806.translation: I've been wanting to start working out lately, but I have no idea how to make a plan. What kind of exercises should I do every day that are suitable for beginners?

m-802.translation: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier? Is it still not too late if I run right now?

errors.span: Is it still not too late if I run right now?
errors.note: 原文“还来得及吗”意为“是否还赶得上/是否还有时间”，译文“not too late”是字面直译，且“still not too late”双重否定造成语义偏差，读起来像在问“还不算太晚吗”，与“是否来得及”的疑问语气不符。

errors.span: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier?
errors.note: “我去”是口语感叹，译成“Damn”语气偏重且带脏话色彩，与原文轻松吐槽的语气略有出入。

m-808.translation: Let me tell you a corny joke.

m-810.translation: This cat's wild moves just left me completely baffled.

m-811.translation: Last night in the middle of the night, my roommate suddenly started telling jokes, like 'Why does Doraemon never drink water?'

m-809.translation: Wealth from all directions, endless good luck, youthful beauty, and a healthy family — someone's trying to turn the security room into a wishing well!

m-814.translation: But I think that last bit of slacking off is sacred.

m-813.translation: You must have planned, produced, or written for the Spring Festival Gala, right? How about you introduce me?

errors.note: “引荐一下”指引荐说话人去见某人（引荐给第三方），译文“introduce me”未体现引荐给他人之意，意思有偏差。
“监制”通常译为 executive producer/supervising producer，“produced”偏向“制作”，语义略有偏差。

m-816.translation: If you livestream, my 15-year streak of not playing games is going to be broken.

m-819.translation: Tell me about your favorite internet slang.

m-812.translation: We've been online for ages, but we still can't keep up with Sister Zhu and Sister Mian when it comes to staying chill.

errors.note: “玩这么久网络”指玩网络/上网很久，译成“online for ages”略偏，但基本可接受；更贴近的是“we've been messing around online this long”。
“朱姐面姐”是昵称/称呼，译成“Sister Zhu and Sister Mian”生硬且不自然，英文口语中一般保留昵称或音译。
“心态还是赶不上”指心态/心理素质比不上，译成“staying chill”偏口语化且略窄，未完全体现“心态”这一层。

m-815.translation: You're already crying from the stress—go comfort them!

errors.span: You're already crying from the stress
errors.note: 原文“你已急哭”是说话人对对方的描述/调侃（“你都快急哭了”），译文却变成“你已经在因压力而哭”，把主语和含义都译错了。
原文“赶紧哄哄啊”是劝对方去哄（对方所指的人），译文用“them”指代不明，且“go comfort them”把对象变成了第三方，与原文语境不符。

m-818.translation: I can't take it anymore—let me hide out for a bit.

m-821.translation: No one remembered my birthday, so I had to buy myself a cake.

m-820.translation: Damn, why didn't you tell me earlier? I've been stuck on this level for three days!

m-817.translation: Wow, 666 — you're not even trying to hide the copying.

errors.note: “666”是中文网络俚语，表示“厉害/牛”，直接保留数字对英文观众没有意义，且“Wow”添加了原文没有的感叹语气。

errors.span: you're not even trying to hide the copying
errors.note: “抄都不掩饰了”指抄袭行为毫不遮掩，译文“copying”尚可，但“not even trying to hide”略偏向“懒得掩饰”，与“都不掩饰了”的直白语气有细微偏差。

m-822.translation: It's better to adopt rather than buy—many adult cats have more stable personalities and are better suited for people with a 9-to-5 job.

m-823.translation: Remember to weigh all ingredients precisely—baking is an exact science.

m-824.translation: If you don't post a new video soon, I'm gonna expose all your embarrassing past.

m-825.translation: My teammates keep forcing me to play support, but I wanna play jungle.

m-826.translation: I can't take this anymore, you come look yourself, bro.

errors.note: 英语表达不自然，更地道的说法是 "come take a look yourself" 或 "you look yourself"。

m-827.translation: I'm thinking of taking my family on a road trip around Shanghai this weekend. Any recommendations for kid-friendly spots within a 2-hour drive?

m-829.translation: No way, no way—you can't make me talk, not even if you kill me!

m-830.translation: Versatile artists are just so charming.

m-828.translation: So what do we do now? Guess it's me again. 666, not even pretending anymore. Why though? I'm out of options. Haha.

errors.note: “666”是中文网络用语，意为“厉害/溜”，此处带讽刺意味；直接保留数字对英文观众无意义，应译为“Nice”或“Wow”等。
“演都不演了”指连装都不装了，译文基本达意，但“pretending”略弱化了“演（演戏/装样子）”的讽刺语气。

m-832.translation: Walked past a pet shop today and saw the cutest hamster.

m-831.translation: This is the kind of meme the internet should actually be hyping.

errors.note: “hype”作动词偏网络营销/炒作语域，与“该火”（值得走红）的褒义口语语气不完全贴合，略显生硬。

m-834.translation: You're insane, hahaha—you're trying to drive the boss crazy too, aren't you?

m-833.translation: No thanks, I don't think I can handle your hotpot.

m-838.translation: But keep in mind, if it's a matter of principle, you should calm down and talk it through properly.

m-839.translation: That's the core of the report.

m-835.translation: Ke Bi totally crashed and burned, hahaha who else gets this, I nearly died laughing in bed

errors.note: “可弊”是网络昵称/人名，音译成“Ke Bi”既不像人名也不自然，观众无法识别这是谁。
“谁懂我”是口语化的共鸣表达，译成“who else gets this”略显生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-840.translation: I was just trying to figure out where to go this weekend, and now you mention hot pot and I'm starving. When do we leave?

m-836.translation: When I first came across that "so what?" thing, the comments were the same few. Now they've all blown up—just wait.

errors.note: “那咋了”是网络流行语/梗，译成“so what?” thing 丢失了梗的指称，观众无法理解具体所指。

errors.span: Now they've all blown up—just wait.
errors.note: 原文“现在都火了别急”意为“现在（这些评论/梗）都火了，别急”，译文把“别急”处理成“just wait”，语气和逻辑偏差，且“they”指代不清。

m-842.translation: The delivery guy knocked over the milk tea I ordered.

m-841.translation: You can definitely get great results working out at home.

m-846.translation: How did you get the homework wrong again?

m-843.translation: He's got his own theme music—you know exactly who's coming.

m-845.translation: Check out this abstract art photo I just took.

m-844.translation: I'd like to get an education savings insurance for my child, but I'm not really sure how to pick the right plan.

m-848.translation: I'm not obligated to check in every night.

m-847.translation: Yeah, especially just grin and bear it — that's just daily life for us working folks.

errors.note: 原文开头“对尤其是受着呗”被压缩成“especially just grin and bear it”，丢失了“对”的确认语气和“呗”的口语语气，且“受着”被译成“grin and bear it”属于意译，语义有偏差。
“了属于是”是网络口语梗，译文“that's just daily life for us working folks”虽达意，但语气偏正式，缺少原文的调侃口吻。

m-849.translation: I'm not talking about Lao Da — I mean Qin Shi Huang. This wave of cultural export is truly next level.

errors.note: “牢大”是网络梗/绰号，音译成“Lao Da”会让英文观众无法理解其指代，属于专有名词处理不当。
“牢大”是带调侃意味的网络称呼，直接音译丢失了其梗义和语气，观众无法获得原意。

m-850.translation: My partner and I often argue about splitting chores. How should we divide housework fairly?

m-852.translation: Binged ten episodes of a variety show in one go.

m-851.translation: My wife suddenly asked me why everyone on WeChat Moments is spamming "verify the card."

errors.note: “刷”指朋友圈被大量转发/刷屏，而“spamming”带有发送垃圾信息的贬义，语义偏差明显。
“验牌”是网络流行语/梗，直译为“verify the card”会让观众误解为真的验证卡片，未能传达其梗的含义。

m-854.translation: Yeah bro, this guy's all about posting weird, nonsensical stuff—just check out his profile and you'll see.

m-853.translation: I can't even—this dish is next-level bizarre.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与“我不行了”的感叹语气不完全对应，略显生硬。
“绝了”是赞叹/惊叹，可褒可贬，译为“next-level bizarre”偏向贬义“怪异”，语义略有偏移。

m-858.translation: My partner suddenly said they wanted to break up with me, but it turned out they were just joking.

m-857.translation: Get your snacks and blanket ready—enjoy a great weekend!

m-860.translation: I can't even—this reply is way too cold.

errors.note: “家人们”是网络直播/短视频中亲昵的群体称呼，译成“guys”偏中性、像普通朋友称呼，丢失了这种亲昵的网络口语语气。

m-859.translation: Can you carry me this game?

m-855.translation: So you've mastered being unstoppable, huh? You could hard-CC hst and the opponent just instantly GG's

errors.span: So you've mastered being unstoppable, huh?
errors.note: “学会无敌了”更接近“you've learned to be invincible/unbeatable”，译成“mastered being unstoppable”略有偏差，但意思大致可通。
原文“可能硬控hst”是推测语气（“might/maybe hard-CC hst”），译文用“could”变成能力/可能性陈述，语气和含义有偏差。
“GG's”作动词用法生硬且时态/搭配不自然，字幕口语中更常说“the opponent just instantly GG's out”或“instantly says GG”。

m-861.translation: It's nutritious and cleaner than takeout.

errors.note: “既保证营养”强调主动确保营养，译文“It's nutritious”仅陈述有营养，弱化了“保证”的含义，但整体意思基本保留。

m-862.translation: You can download apps like Keep or Nike Training Club and follow along with their workout programs.

m-865.translation: So what? That's just my thing.

m-864.translation: Take it seriously — youth doesn't come back, but the memories stay.

m-863.translation: Little Yang Ge is totally uninhibited when he's filming videos, but he was a nervous wreck when he went to accept an award.

m-866.translation: I'm begging you, teacher, don't put this on the test.

m-867.translation: Looks like there's already a trailer out—I've even come across promo videos for her movie.

m-868.translation: I had three servings of stinky tofu today.

m-869.translation: Damn, I'm done for—my legs have completely given out.

m-870.translation: Tried to give the cat a haircut and it ended up square.

m-872.translation: These films deliver stunning visual effects and profound meaning—watching them will give you a fresh perspective on reality.

m-873.translation: The most important thing is to look professional like a teacher. Business casual is recommended for attire—avoid anything too flashy.

m-875.translation: The game's about to get a new update.

m-874.translation: The delivery guy dropped my milk tea.

m-871.translation: The moment you get caught sneaking glances at your crush in class

m-876.translation: The payment page for the Double 11 sale keeps freezing.

m-879.translation: I'd suggest saving a few well-written reports from your colleagues as reference—you'll get the hang of it soon enough.

m-883.translation: My roommate left the dishes unwashed again—they've been piling up for a week.

m-877.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I thought I just wasn't trying hard enough.

m-880.translation: That's honestly such a weird thing to do—if I'd been there, I'd have been dying of secondhand embarrassment.

m-878.translation: Holy crap, I stubbed my toe so hard I got paronychia!

errors.note: “六百六十六”是网络用语，表示厉害/牛，译成“Holy crap”语气偏惊讶/粗俗，与原意不符。

errors.span: I stubbed my toe so hard I got paronychia
errors.note: “磕到甲沟炎了”是夸张说法，指磕碰后引发甲沟炎，译文改成“stubbed my toe so hard”属于增译具体动作，且“so hard I got”把因果关系说得过于直白，偏离原意。

m-881.translation: I'm preparing for the teacher qualification certificate exam soon—any efficient study methods you can share?

m-886.translation: I'm not obligated to tell you!

errors.note: 原文为无人称的客观陈述（“没有告知的义务”），译文加上第一人称“I'm”，把一般性义务表述变成了说话者个人的声明，略微改变了主语范围。

m-884.translation: I can't even — it's literally identical.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，语气偏轻佻、带调侃，与原文“我不行了”表达承受不住/招架不住的口语感叹语气不完全对应，略显不自然。

m-888.translation: Among mainstream brands, the Ecovacs T10 offers a well-rounded performance, the Roborock G10 focuses on mopping, and Xiaomi offers great value for money.

m-885.translation: That's so unhinged I literally lost my mind on the spot.

errors.note: “抽象”指内容晦涩难懂或荒诞，而“unhinged”意为疯狂失控，语义偏差明显。

errors.span: literally lost my mind on the spot
errors.note: “原地裂开”是网络夸张说法，表示当场崩溃，译成“lost my mind”略重但基本可接受，属轻微增译。

m-889.translation: Hahaha I can't even, I'm so jealous of that hair volume.

m-887.translation: I can't take it anymore—I'm seriously about to burst from eating so much.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此语境是“我吃不下了/受不了了（撑得不行）”，译成“I can't take it anymore”偏向情绪崩溃，语义有偏差。

errors.span: I'm seriously about to burst from eating so much
errors.note: 过于冗长书面，不像字幕口语；原文“这波属实是撑死”更简短俏皮。

m-882.translation: So when people say 'you ji ku' they actually mean 'you're so anxious you're crying' — last time someone mocked me like that, I just shot back 'bounce it right back at you.'

errors.note: 原文“你已疾苦”是谐音梗，译文只给拼音未体现“疾苦”的字面/谐音双关，观众无法理解笑点来源。
“急哭”译为 anxious 略偏，原意更接近“急得哭出来”，但大意可通。

errors.span: bounce it right back at you
errors.note: “反弹”是网络用语（把嘲讽反弹回去），译文加 it right back at you 略显冗长生硬，不够口语化。

m-893.translation: When I'm at a loss for words, I just start throwing labels at people.

m-890.translation: I recommend watching movies together on the Weiguang app, and there are also couple-only apps like 'Love Diary'.

errors.note: “微光”作为应用名通常音译为“Weiguang”，但直接音译可能让英文观众无法识别，建议保留原名或加注说明。

errors.span: there are also couple-only apps like 'Love Diary'
errors.note: “there are also”偏书面，字幕口语中更自然的是“plus”或“and apps like”，但意思无误。

m-891.translation: Can you clear my shopping cart for Double Eleven?

m-895.translation: The key is to survey everyone's interests in advance and arrange some icebreaker games to boost interaction.

m-892.translation: The Qing Dynasty's been gone for ages—why are we still doing this pointless formalities crap?

errors.note: “this pointless formalities crap”中 this 与复数 formalities 搭配不当，且 crap 与 formalities 组合生硬，语法不通顺。
“crap”语气粗俗，与原文“形式主义”的批评语气不完全对应，字幕口语化但略显过火。

m-897.translation: I came up with a prank—pretend to jump off a building.

m-894.translation: The 'read but reply nonsense' meme has been around for a while. This video is boring and wasn't even popular, yet it suddenly showed up on the trending list. I'm literally speechless.

errors.note: 直译生硬，不像自然的英文网络用语，可改为更口语化的说法如 'reading without reading / replying at random'。
“无语”在此是无奈/无语吐槽，译成“literally speechless”偏字面，语气略有偏差。

m-899.translation: The advisor suddenly sent this message in the group chat.

m-896.translation: I need to check the cards. We have to see it in slow motion.

errors.note: “验牌”指查验/核对牌（可能指扑克牌或牌面），译成“check the cards”尚可，但若语境是查验牌的真伪或点数，则“check”偏笼统；更关键的是原文“验牌”与“慢动作回放”是同一动作的两个要求，译文拆成两句并加了“We have to”，语气和结构有偏移。

errors.span: We have to see it in slow motion
errors.note: 原文“必须慢动作回放”是要求对“验牌”这一动作进行慢放回看，译文用“see it”指代不明，且“have to”语气与“必须”对应但整体把“回放”弱化为“看”，丢失了“回放”的含义。

m-898.translation: Quit yapping about it here—wait till I get back to the country and I'll deal with it.

errors.note: “回国”指回到自己的国家，译文“get back to the country”字面意为“回到乡下/这个国家”，容易误解，应为“get back home”或“return to my country”。
“呲”在此为方言口语，指胡说/唠叨，译文用“yapping”基本达意，但“about it”略增译，且整体语气稍显生硬。

m-901.translation: Isn't it enough that I can understand it myself?

m-902.translation: Bro, I lost my phone and I urgently need to log into WeChat—do you know what my WeChat password is?

m-900.translation: So it was a meme all along—all I knew was how serious I looked when I wanted to check the cards.

errors.span: all I knew was how serious I looked when I wanted to check the cards
errors.note: 原文“我只知道我要验牌那严肃样”意思是“我只知道自己要验牌时那副严肃的样子”，译文误将“验牌”处理成“想验牌”，并把“那严肃样”变成“我看起来多严肃”，语义有偏差。

errors.span: So it was a meme all along—all I knew was
errors.note: 破折号后接“all I knew was”略显生硬，且“原来这是个梗”与“我只知道……”之间的转折关系在译文中不够自然。

m-903.translation: The cafeteria lady gave me exactly 666 grams of rice.

errors.note: 原文只说“打了666克”，并未强调“正好/恰好”，exactly 属于轻微增译，改变了语气。

m-904.translation: I watched the Liaoning Spring Festival Gala yesterday.

m-908.translation: As this old dad, I have to stay up late researching this meme—just so I don't fall behind my kid.

m-909.translation: Funny? Why won't the prophet give me a bird?

m-906.translation: Please, just tell them not to come. They're so loud, so annoying, and honestly they drive me crazy.

errors.span: just tell them not to come
errors.note: 原文是说话人恳求“他们”别来，译文却变成让听话人去转告他们别来，改变了施事和请求对象。
原文无此语气副词，添加后略改变口语语气，属轻微增译。

m-907.translation: The dance move you copied is actually a parody version.

errors.note: “跟着跳”指跟着一起跳，不是“复制”，copied 改变了动作含义。
字幕口语中“parody version”略显生硬，用“parody”或“spoof version”更自然。

m-910.translation: I told my roommate I was starving, and she just went, "Sure, sure."

m-912.translation: I can't anymore, babe. Let's look at it tomorrow.

m-913.translation: I want to give my living room a new look—what decor styles are popular right now?

m-905.translation: Ji Hongxing, coffin, ancestor, my sword and shield, Hajimi, Milk Dragon—this is a top-tier account!

errors.note: “季洪行”是三个字的中文名，译成“Ji Hongxing”把“洪行”当成名字，但原文更像是“季洪”加“行”（走/出发），或是一个三字名，译名处理不当。
“老祖”在口语/网络语境中译成“ancestor”过于直译生硬，不够自然。
“刀盾”是游戏装备/角色名，译成“sword and shield”把“刀”误作“剑”，术语不准确。
“哈基米”是网络流行语/梗，音译尚可，但作为专有梗词处理可更一致。
“奶龙”是特定IP/角色名，直译“Milk Dragon”不够规范，宜保留或采用通行译名。

m-911.translation: I've been wanting to learn skateboarding lately but keep worrying about falling—what tips and safety measures should beginners keep in mind?

m-915.translation: Can you help me copy the homework?

m-916.translation: Just suck it up—isn't that how it is for all of us wage slaves?

m-914.translation: No worries, bro—this story is just too wild.

errors.note: “包的”是网络俚语，表示“当然/没问题/包在我身上”，译成“No worries”（别担心）改变了语气和含义，属于误译。

m-917.translation: The show I was binge-watching suddenly went downhill.

errors.note: “烂尾”指剧集结局糟糕或质量崩坏，而“went downhill”泛指整体质量下滑，未准确传达“结局烂尾”的含义。

m-918.translation: Don't worry, I'll actually take it seriously this time.

m-920.translation: I secretly brought five phones to class and took turns gaming on them.

m-921.translation: I ran three marathons and my legs feel like jelly.

m-922.translation: If you still don't hand in this homework, I'm telling the teacher.

errors.note: 原文“就告诉老师”是将来时威胁（I'll tell the teacher），译文用现在进行时“I'm telling”改变了时态和语气，暗示正在告知，意思有偏差。

m-924.translation: Wait till I'm back to deal with this—then we'll see who's begging who.

m-923.translation: We're thinking about setting up a smart home, but I've heard devices from different brands might not be compatible. How should we choose to avoid that issue?

m-919.translation: Eating while getting hit with a sad flashback—that's like rubbing salt in the wound and then asking if it's salty enough. Absolutely brutal.

errors.note: “绝了”是表示惊叹/无语的感叹，译为“Absolutely brutal”偏向“太狠了”，语气略有偏移，但整体可接受。

m-926.translation: What time did the boss say we're working till?

m-925.translation: I posted a bunch of goofy jokes on my Moments.

m-927.translation: I followed an influencer's tutorial to plan a surprise for my girlfriend, and she ended up getting mad.

m-928.translation: Okay, I'll tell him in a bit.

m-929.translation: Your crush vs your bestie—who's better looking?

errors.note: “你心动”指“让你心动的人”，译成“your crush”变成“你暗恋的人”，主语关系颠倒，意思有偏差。

m-931.translation: Can you really keep studying like this?

m-930.translation: I thought it was a monologue, but it turned out to be a voiceover.

m-933.translation: Because you went from being the big man on campus to a nobody.

m-932.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? You really kept that hidden!

m-937.translation: I can't even—this is absolutely mind-blowing.

m-934.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I missed the first release!

errors.note: “Damn”作为感叹词偏重，原文“我去”是较轻的口语感叹，语气略强。
“首发”在影视/产品语境常指“premiere/first showing”，译作“first release”略显生硬，但可理解。

m-939.translation: I've been working for two years and want to switch jobs, but I keep getting asked 'why are you leaving' in interviews—what's the best way to answer that?

m-935.translation: What do I do when my boss keeps gaslighting me and I still have to work overtime?

errors.note: “PUA”在此语境指职场操控/打压，译成“gaslighting”偏窄且带特定心理学术语色彩，与原文泛指的职场PUA不完全对应。

errors.span: What do I do when my boss keeps gaslighting me and I still have to work overtime?
errors.note: 整句偏书面、冗长，作为字幕口语不够简洁自然。

m-940.translation: Oh my God, I can't even—it's breathtaking.

m-936.translation: Ever heard of the Shanghai big shot flex?

errors.note: “沪爷”是网络俚语，指上海本地人（常带调侃/自嘲意味），并非“big shot”（大人物），此处误译了含义。
“冲击”在此俚语语境中更接近“冲击/来袭/风潮”的意思，译成“flex”（炫耀）语气和含义都不太贴切。

m-938.translation: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier? I'm already seeing little people dancing.

errors.span: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier?
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的抱怨，译文用“Damn, why didn't you say that earlier?”语气偏重且略生硬，不够像字幕口语。

errors.span: I'm already seeing little people dancing.
errors.note: “看到小人跳舞”是中文里形容出现幻觉/眼花的固定说法，直译为“seeing little people dancing”在英文中不自然，可能让观众误解为真的看到小人，建议意译为 seeing things / hallucinating。

m-943.translation: Take it seriously, okay? And don't forget to bring a gift.

m-941.translation: So what? Like anyone cares. Those two together? Absolutely priceless—peak comedy.

errors.note: 原文“谁理你”是陈述/反问语气（没人理你），译文“Like anyone cares”字面意为“好像有人在乎似的”，语义方向相反，造成意思偏差。
“priceless”“peak comedy”偏书面/网络梗化表达，与字幕口语语气略不协调，但意思基本传达。

m-942.translation: The blogger shared some funny campus content. "Honestly, using yours just wouldn't feel right for me" — that meme is way too real.

errors.span: 你那根我用确实不太合适
errors.note: 原文“你那根我用确实不太合适”被译成“using yours just wouldn't feel right for me”，丢失了“那根”的具体指代（暗示某物/某部位），意思被泛化，与原梗的暗示不符。
“这个梗”译为“that meme”尚可，但“过于真实”译为“way too real”基本达意，属可接受范围，仅提示语气略强。

m-945.translation: With this budget, I'd go with a Wi-Fi 6 router—better signal coverage and stability.

m-946.translation: We could agree to meet once a month to keep things fresh in the relationship.

m-947.translation: I wanna start a fangirl emo vent group—we can talk about our idols or just go crazy. Only accepting girls born after 2000.

errors.note: “00后”通常指2000–2009年出生的人，而“born after 2000”字面意思是2000年之后出生，范围略宽，可能包含2010年后出生的人。

m-948.translation: I'm dying laughing at that video on the homepage where the celebrity claims she's a size 36.5 and then totally gets caught out.

errors.note: 中文“36码半”指中国鞋码36.5码，译成“size 36.5”在英语中会被理解为欧码36.5，而欧码36.5约等于中国码36，尺码体系不同，观众会得到错误信息。

m-949.translation: Why do my videos get throttled as soon as I post them?

m-950.translation: Crying cat meme.jpg — mishearing lyrics is such a struggle

errors.note: “空耳人”指把歌词听错成谐音的人，译文“mishearing lyrics”只保留了动作，丢失了“人”这一主语，意思有偏差。

errors.span: mishearing lyrics is such a struggle
errors.note: “太难了”是网络口语化吐槽，译文用“such a struggle”略显书面，语气不够贴近字幕口语。
